acceptanceCriteria: plugin.json and the marketplace entry carry homepage, repository, license (AGPL-3.0-or-later per LICENSING.md), and author url.
Description and README wording match the release channel actually shipped; the FALLBACK support level stays disclosed.
Every hook statusMessage states the user-visible action in plain words.
claude plugin validate passes with no warnings; the host package version check passes.
body: Found in a 2026-10-09 audit of the Claude Code plugin (corvint@corvint 0.2.3, Claude Code 2.1.293, Corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 build 360, darwin-arm64). claude plugin validate passes, but: plugin.json and the marketplace entry have no homepage, repository or license, and author has no url/email; displayName is set, but description and the marketplace say 'Developer-preview' while the core is 1.0.0-rc.2; hook statusMessage text is internal jargon ('Checking Corvint frontier availability', 'Recording Corvint observation'); SessionEnd has no statusMessage. The marketplace version is 0.1.0 and adapterVersion is 0.1.0 (V1-0444) while the plugin is 0.2.3. Docs: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/manifest-reference.md (homepage, repository, license, keywords are shown in /plugin; icon is read only by Anthropic's directory).
title: Claude Code plugin presentation: manifest metadata, preview wording and hook spinner text for a 1.0 release
